cells.tense: You are here with the pen, and the shape is mostly yours.
cells.act: give directions plainly, once, and let them walk
cells.ask: When someone asks the way this week, say it plainly once, then keep your hand off the wheel while they walk it.
cells.core:
You can build when the road isn't fully lit yet. Enough light to take the next step, not enough to see the whole way, and you're content with that — you make the call from what you have, and the step you take shows you the one coming after it. The work turns out usable, which is what a thing looking for a shape needs.

The scale of what you're building holds more of your voice than you've said. Give one direction plainly this week, once, then step back while the person carries it. When the instruction doesn't come back for correction, notice what was actually in the deciding. What you're building isn't waiting for a clearer question. It is already taking.
cells.sheetLine: You can build when the road isn't fully lit yet.
cells.verb: Building the first shape of something new with skilled hands

cells.tense: You are bracing for a future that hasn't given you the road yet.
cells.act: go deeper into the shared thing than comfort allows
cells.ask: Take one shared thing further than is comfortable — past the polite version — and drop the gathering that has gone hollow.
cells.core:
When the fit is uncertain, you build the next thing in advance, and then the next, trying to make the unclear part go away by getting ahead of it. The blueprint gets better and better and the ground under it gets less and less sure. Something more solid is being held off by the wait.

What connects people is what you're building toward, and it doesn't reveal itself from a distance. Stay in one shared thing past the easy stopping place, and leave the hollow version of it behind. Show up where you'd actually be met. What you find there won't arrive as a plan. It'll arrive as knowing what the build is for.
cells.sheetLine: You're building ahead to stop the ground being unsure.
cells.verb: Building the first shape of something new with skilled hands

cells.tense: You are standing at a door that opened into a room you can't see.
cells.act: move with the clarity that needs no assertion
cells.ask: Take the decision you've been circling and carry it through the day — no memo first, no second opinions — the doing is the answer.
cells.core:
You're waiting for enough of the plan to arrive before you start, and the wait has stretched past the room it was for. A door closed a while back and the decision that goes with it was left standing open. The skilled hands are still there. They just aren't on anything at the moment.

What you can raise in the dark is one call. Take the decision you've been circling and carry it through the day without writing it up first. The structure you make yourself lights the next step; a decision doesn't need explaining to be a decision. What you decide does not need the room to be clear.
cells.sheetLine: You're waiting for a plan the wait has made harder.
cells.verb: Building the first shape of something new with skilled hands

cells.tense: You're holding the pen down in a room you're already writing in.
cells.act: refuse the pull off course, once more
cells.ask: When the direction gets pushed on next, refuse that pull once — keep the heading you chose before you redraw anything.
cells.core:
The call is being made, and someone else gets thanked for it. When the direction holds, you say the plan came from the group, the timing, or the way things happened to land. The system is running and the author's name is filed under circumstance. What's yours is genuinely yours.

Say one direction as yours this week, once, in whatever way fits the room, and keep the heading when the push comes. You don't have to defend it forever; one day is enough to see the difference. What's already in your hands is ready to be handed over. This is the hand it wants.
cells.sheetLine: The direction is yours and you're filing it under the group.
cells.verb: Building the first shape of something new with skilled hands
